justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/NodeUtils.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Node.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Element.java, and src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Printer.java. NodeUtils is a package-private helper with only 5 static methods and modest fan-out (imports Validate, W3CDom, HtmlTreeBuilder, Parser, NodeList plus JDK stream/collection types). Its fan-in is limited to 3 production classes: Node.java (3 call sites), Element.java (8 call sites), and Printer.java (1 call site). That is shared internal utility usage, not a high-in/high-out dependency hub.
